messages:
Ashley: quick heads-up — prepping an ingest for model zeta-13b-v2. Need a quick gating pass: confirm weights location + ACLs, tokenizer mapping quirk, and manifest checksum. found 2 shard files that failed checksum on our mirror. pinging infra + model onboarding.

Sana: path?

Ashley: huggingface: https://huggingface.co/org/zeta-13b-v2
registry path: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b-v2/2026-03-15/
example missing: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b-v2/2026-03-15/pytorch_model-00002-of-00008.bin (sha256 mismatch)

Pravin: if they're using the tokenizer.json from HF, note we've seen BOS token duplicated on that release — causes off-by-one in generation. Quick workaround: set add_bos=false in tokenizer init or use the legacy vocab + merges. Example:
```
tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file("tokenizer.json")
# pseudo API for clarity
tokenizer.post_processor.add_bos = False
```

Mike: infra can presign downloads. default TTL is 1h, can do up to 12h for onboarding. which do you want? also I'll run an acl sweep.

Ashley: can you do 6h please. checksum details:
expected: 3a7f2b9c...c9 (sha256)
mirror showed: 4b2e1d5a...d1
I re-downloaded locally and got expected -> likely partial mirror upload. logs:
`curl -o /tmp/part.bin <url> && sha256sum /tmp/part.bin`

ingest-bot: artifact-register job started for zeta-13b-v2 at 2034567905, status: verification pending.

Sana: @Mike can you confirm s3 ACL for team-ml includes `artifact:read`? and that presign scope allows getObject?

Mike: confirmed. added `artifact:read` to group `eng-ml` and created presign policy `model-ingest-temp` TTL=6h. ACLs applied to s3 prefix. Also updated IAM role `ingest-runner` with s3:GetObject.

Pravin: for the tokenizer fix I'll open a tiny PR to onboarding that toggles add_bos via model config. PR #3124. @Ashley can you add a small unit test that decodes a short prompt to check offset?

Ashley: will add test. quick patch coming.

Irene: LGTM on the ACL change, ran a quick download + verify on a sample shard post-fix — checksum matches now. if all good, we'll flip the mirror/complete ingest and run smoke eval.

Ashley: thanks all. follow-ups: PR #3124 (tokenizer), ashley/tests/ingest-ci branch for checksum test, Mike will tag presigned URLs in onboarding logs. target finish today EOD.

Mike: presigned URLs tagged in logs as `presign:6h` and pushed policy to prod. also rotated the mirror upload job to retry incomplete uploads.

Pravin: quick note — eval infra sometimes caches tokenizer.json; restart `eval-cache` if you see stray mismatches.

Ashley: noted. closing here once ingest pipeline reports success. :thumbsup:
